query:
SELECT 
  c.id,
  c.claim_number,
  c.status,
  c.vehicle_make,
  c.vehicle_model,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pbq.id) AS quote_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT qli.id) AS line_item_count,
  MAX(pbq.updated_at) AS last_quote_update
FROM claims c
LEFT JOIN panel_beater_quotes pbq ON pbq.claim_id = c.id
LEFT JOIN quote_line_items qli ON qli.claim_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.claim_number, c.status, c.vehicle_make, c.vehicle_model
ORDER BY quote_count DESC, line_item_count DESC
LIMIT 10;
